items.title: CRA Competition advises on European Commission’s unconditional Phase II clearance of Mars/Kellanova
items.summary: On 7 of December 2025, the European Commission unconditionally cleared Mars/Kellanova after an in-depth Phase II investigation. Unusually for a Phase II case, the Commission’s theory of harm revolved around ‘portfolio’ or ‘conglomerate’ effects. The Commission was concerned that post-merger, by jointly negotiating, the combined entity of Mars/Kellanova would improve their bargaining position vis-à-vis retailers […]

items.summary: CRA experts Raphaël De Coninck and Mikaël Hervé assisted Credit Suisse in relation to an antitrust investigation in exchanges of information in the FOREX market. Their contributions helped secure a substantial reduction of the European Commission’s fine for Credit Suisse, from €83 million to €29 million. items.summary: CRA supported Lesaffre in its acquisitions of DSM-Firmenich’s yeast extract business and its joint venture with Zilor Group. items.summary: CRA Competition supported Microsoft’s historic $69 billion acquisition of Activision Blizzard, providing expertise across all jurisdictions—including the FTC challenge, the European Commission and CMA review processes, and clearance decisions by dozens of other countries worldwide. items.title: CRA successfully assisted client in investigation into Google’s conduct of maps and automotive services offerings
items.summary: The German Federal Cartel Office has issued two decisions accepting Google’s commitments regarding its Google Maps Platform (“GMP”) services and its Google Automotive Services (“GAS”) offering. items.title: CRA successfully assisted client in EC antitrust investigation in tech labour markets
items.summary: The EC opened an investigation into practices related to a non-solicitation agreement between two major manufacturing technology companies. A CRA team including Mikaël Hervé, Chara Tzanetaki, Mariam Arutyunyan, and David Meijer advised one of the companies during the European Commission’s investigation. items.title: CRA advises two manufacturers of household appliances in a vertical restraints investigation in France
items.summary: On 19 December 2024, the French Competition Authority imposed a €611 million fine on ten manufacturers and two distributors of household appliances for vertical price fixing practices in France.
